name: Herdsman Falla

intro.text: Golden Guernsey milk, from the cows I talk to every morning. They never talk back, which is why I like them.

win: Oh well. The cows won't be pleased with me, but there it is.
after: My great-grandfather kept Guernseys on this headland. We've never let any other cow through the gate, and we've been pestered about it.
